question.text: A biconvex lens of focal length $f$ and radii of curvature of both the surfaces $R$ is made of a material of refractive index $n_{1}$. This lens is placed in a liquid of refractive index $n_{2}$. Now this lens will behave like

options.text: either as a convex or as a concave lens depending solely on $\mathrm{R}$
a convex lens depending on $n_{1}$ and $n_{2}$
a concave lens depending on $n_{1}$ and $n_{2}$
a convex lens of same focal length irrespective of $R, n_{1}$ and $n_{2}$

solution.text: The lens will behave like a convex lens or a concave lens depending upon the value of $n_{1}$ and $n_{2}$.
